Definition 499Oriented affine interval form

In the fixed affine coordinate, the interval alternating one-form has coefficient \(1/(t(1-t))\). Its regular geometric domain is \(0{\lt}t{\lt}1\).

Definition 507Oriented affine square form

In the fixed affine orientation, the square alternating two-form has coefficient \(1/(xy(1-x)(1-y))\). Its regular interior is \(0{\lt}x,y{\lt}1\).

LaTeX Lean
Definition 503Oriented affine triangle form

The alternating area form has coefficient \(1/(xy(1-x-y))\) in the fixed orientation, with regular triangle domain \(x{\gt}0\), \(y{\gt}0\), \(x+y{\lt}1\). This is not a general projective existence theorem.
